business_summary: Eagle Financial Services, Inc. operates as the bank holding company for Bank of Clarke that provides various retail and commercial banking products and services in the United States. It operates through three segments: Community Banking, Marine Lending, and Wealth Management. The company's deposit products include checking, NOW, money market, and regular savings accounts; and demand and time deposits, as well as other commercial deposit account services, such as ACH origination and remote deposit capture services. Its loan portfolio comprises one-to-four-family residential real estate, commercial real estate, construction and land development, and commercial and industrial loans, marine lending, and consumer lending, as well as secured and unsecured consumer loans, including personal installment loans, personal lines of credit, automobile loans, and credit card loans. In addition, the company offers advisory services and investment products, including individual retirement accounts, mutual funds, tax-deferred annuities, 529 college savings plans, life insurance, long term care insurance, brokerage certificates of deposit, and other brokerage services; non-deposit investment products; and title insurance products. Further, it provides debit cards; fiduciary services; online bill payment services; and telephone, internet, and mobile banking services. It operates through full-service branches, loan production offices, wealth management offices, and drive-through only facility. Eagle Financial Services, Inc. was founded in 1881 and is headquartered in Berryville, Virginia.
business_summary_ko: Eagle Financial Services, Inc.는 미국에서 다양한 소매 및 상업 은행 상품과 서비스를 제공하는 Bank of Clarke의 은행 지주 회사로 운영됩니다. 커뮤니티 뱅킹, 해양 대출 및 자산 관리의 세 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사의 예금 상품에는 당좌예금, NOW, 머니마켓, 정기예금 계좌가 포함됩니다. 수요 예금 및 정기 예금은 물론 ACH 개시 및 원격 예금 회수 서비스와 같은 기타 상업 예금 계좌 서비스도 포함됩니다. 대출 포트폴리오는 1~4가구 주거용 부동산, 상업용 부동산, 건설 및 토지 개발, 상업 및 산업 대출, 해양 대출, 소비자 대출뿐만 아니라 개인 할부 대출, 개인 신용 한도, 자동차 대출, 신용 카드 대출을 포함한 담보 및 무담보 소비자 대출로 구성됩니다. 또한 회사는 개인 퇴직 계좌, 뮤추얼 펀드, 세금 연기 연금, 529 대학 저축 계획, 생명 보험, 장기 요양 보험, 중개 예금 증서 및 기타 중개 서비스를 포함한 자문 서비스 및 투자 상품을 제공합니다. 무예금 투자상품
